summary: Page geometry matches the official 2018 PDF well, but Page 2 numeric columns are left-aligned, Part V Schedule 1 seller/buyer/corp/base print blank, and screen Item 4 truncates the TIN branch code while Item 11 omits the 11B IPO label.

defects.where: Page 2, Part IV, Part V (Schedules 1-3), and Part VI numeric columns
defects.what: Amount Involved, Number of Shares, Tax Base, Tax Rate, Tax Due, and Total values all print left-aligned instead of right-aligned.

defects.where: Page 2, Part V Schedule 1 (Seller, Buyer, Issuing Corporation, Number of Shares, Tax Base)
defects.what: Schedule 1 rows 1-4 print Dates (06/15/2026) but Seller, Buyer, Issuing Corporation, Number of Shares, and Tax Base print blank/0.00 despite being filled.

defects.where: Page 1, Items 7 (Registered Address), 7A (ZIP Code), 9 (Email), and 10A (Tax Relief Specify)
defects.what: Address, Email, and 10A Specify collide with comb ticks; Email prints lowercase; Item 7A ZIP Code prints blank.
The 5-digit branch code (00000) is truncated with ellipsis (000...) in the read-only TIN box.
Segmented options show "11A Shares of Stocks Listed and Traded through the LSE | Primary | Secondary" without the "11B Initial Public Offering" label for Primary/Secondary.

shared_changes_wanted: crates/bir-print: comb-overflow fitting and uppercase formatting for Items 7, 9, and 10A
nsh/screens/form: widen 5-digit TIN branch code box so 00000 does not truncate to 000...
